purpose: Document first-party cadastral-source discovery and bounded anonymous access review for Attock, Pakistan.
assessment: The official Punjab PULSE urban land-system viewer is city-relevant: its current public HTML advertises an Attock Cadastral Maps layer. The viewer configuration exposed the Punjab_Cdastral_Maps ArcGIS MapServer route, but anonymous metadata and layer requests returned ArcGIS error 499 Token Required. No parcel geometry or native parcel identity was retained; runtime remains held.
